terminal_record.title: Unverified Claim of Broad February 2025 CDC Reproductive-Health Grant Cuts
terminal_record.description_short: The supplied record alleges broad CDC reproductive-health grant cuts in February 2025; the scope, date, and affected awards remain unverified.
terminal_record.description_medium: The supplied record alleges that the Trump administration ended CDC grants and programs related to abortion research, contraception, and reproductive health in February 2025. It also claims programs and researchers lost awards. The HHS award table shows individual CDC grant terminations on later 2025 dates, but does not establish the alleged blanket February action or its scope.
terminal_record.description_long: The supplied entry alleges that the Trump administration ended CDC grants and programs related to abortion research, contraception, and reproductive health in February 2025. It claims that programs for contraception counseling, teen pregnancy prevention, and maternal-health research lost funding, and that researchers had awards canceled mid-study. The same account predicts disproportionate effects on low-income and rural patients and reports advocates’ concern about unintended pregnancies; these are supplied claims, not documented outcomes in this draft. The available TAGGS excerpt shows one CDC award with a later 2025 termination date, involving birth defects and pregnant and postpartum health. It does not identify a February-wide action or show that all grants in these areas ended. The supplied information therefore does not establish the date, recipients, program scope, or effects of the alleged cancellation. No claim is made here that the listed programs were all terminated.
